description.short: Check Microsoft Project data quality and consistency.
description.full:
PDS MPP Data Auditor helps project managers, PMO analysts, schedulers, and project controls teams find data-quality issues in Microsoft Project (.mpp) plans in Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams. Select an MPP file you can access in OneDrive or SharePoint. The agent reviews task and resource relationships, hierarchy, dates, progress, calendars, custom fields, open ends, float, and critical-path signals; it can also compare plan versions when requested. It returns evidence-based findings and prioritized recommendations to help teams assess plan reliability. It does not determine compliance or replace professional review.

The agent is read-only and does not change or delete the selected source project. If requested, Microsoft 365 Code Interpreter can create Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or PDF reports as temporary downloads. Reports are not uploaded to OneDrive or SharePoint by the agent. Review findings against the source plan; missing optional data is not automatically a defect.

An active PDS account and access to Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams are required to use this app. You also need permission to access the selected MPP and any OneDrive or SharePoint files, email, or Teams messages used as context. Teams sign-in alone does not sign you in to PDS. Search is limited to content your account can access. Usage is subject to account limits. After your app access is enabled, your PDS account is automatically created and assigned to the Freemium plan when you first sign in through MCP. You can start directly in Microsoft 365 Copilot; no separate PDS web-portal visit or account sign-up is required. If you need to request access, visit https://projectdata.io/project-ai. The PDS portal is also available at https://my.projectdata.ai. Help Center: https://pdms.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/categories/40422614580893-ProjectData-AI. Contact Us: https://projectdata.io/contact-us or support@projectdata.io. Supported language: English.
